name: Jump to a moment
author: Izumi
description: Describe a scene and the player jumps to it. Uses the episode's subtitles and a chat model: sign in with ChatGPT or OpenRouter, paste an API key, or use a model on your computer.

network.reason: Sends your question, the title and the episode's subtitle lines to the model service you choose, and nowhere else. Sign-in goes to OpenAI or OpenRouter in your browser; chatgpt.com is only opened for your ChatGPT usage page.

settings.label: OpenRouter model
settings.description: Used when you sign in with OpenRouter. Each is that maker's newest model of its kind.

settings.description: Used when you are not signed in above.

settings.description: Skips everything after where you are now, so a search never spoils what's ahead.
